userStories.title: Implement PrismaAuditStorage and private module bindings
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Adapt the installed audit package's record interface to the AuditEntry repository and register singleton aliases in AuditLogModule.

**Motivation** — Nothing stores that context yet.

**Approach** — `PrismaAuditStorage implements IAuditStorage` (`src/audit/prisma-audit.storage.ts`). `record(entry)` validates, then calls the repository's `create` with:

| `AuditEntry` (package) | column |
|:--|:--|
| `action` | `key` |
| `resource` | `resourceType` |
| `resourceId` | `resourceId` |
| `actor.type`, `actor.id` | `actorType`, `actorId` |
| `correlationId` | `correlationId` |
| `timestamp` | `createdAt` |
| `metadata.projectId` | `projectId` |
| `metadata.onBehalfOf` | `onBehalfOfType`, `onBehalfOfId` (both null when absent) |
| `metadata.origin` | `origin` |
| `metadata.approval` | `requiredMode`, `satisfiedBy`, `approverType`, `approverId`, `approvalRequestId` (from `requestId`); each optional approval field null when absent |
| `metadata.summary` | `summary` |

Validation checks, in this order: `actor`, `actor.type`, `resource`, `resourceId`, `correlationId`, `metadata`, `metadata.origin`, `metadata.approval`. The first one missing throws `Error('audit entry is not a koda audit entry: <field>')`, and `create` is not called. `AuditLogModule` provides the storage as `{ provide: AUDIT_STORAGE, useExisting: PrismaAuditStorage }`. It imports nothing: `PrismaModule` (with `TRANSACTION_MANAGER`) and the permissions providers are global.

**Design notes** — **The package's `AuditModule` is not imported.** `AuditModule` (4.2.3) eagerly builds `AuditInterceptor`, which needs the `CLOCK` token, and `RequestContextService`, none of which koda uses. Koda imports only the package's types (`IAuditStorage`, `AuditEntry`) and its `AUDIT_STORAGE` token, and its own module provides the storage under that token.

**The koda module is `AuditLogModule`** (`src/audit/audit-log.module.ts`). The name avoids clashing with the package's `AuditModule`. The package's `AuditEntry` interface is imported as `PackageAuditEntry` (`import type { AuditEntry as PackageAuditEntry } from '@nathapp/nestjs-audit'`), because the generated Prisma model has the same name.

**Koda's extra fields travel in `AuditEntry.metadata`.** The package entry has `action`, `actor`, `resource`, `resourceId`, `correlationId`, `timestamp` and `metadata`. The recorder puts `projectId`, `onBehalfOf`, `origin`, `approval` and `summary` into `metadata` as a `KodaAuditMetadata`, and the storage maps them to columns. `action` holds the permission key, and `resource` holds the resource type.

**The storage implements `record` only.** `query` is optional in the package. `GET /api/audit` needs pagination plus approver and project filters, which `AuditQueryFilter` lacks, so the route reads through `AuditLogService.list` → the repository's `findPage`.

The module binds `{ provide: AUDIT_ENTRY_REPOSITORY, useExisting: PrismaAuditEntryRepository }`. The storage depends on the token, and the service injects the concrete class for `findPage`. Neither is exported.

**Scope** — In: adapter, module and token aliases, DB-free DI proofs. Out: AppModule import and recorder export (US-003), recorder refusal/rollback behavior (US-004), list service export (US-005), controller registration (US-006); do not import package AuditModule or implement IAuditStorage.query.

**Interface** — `PrismaAuditStorage implements IAuditStorage`; `record(entry: PackageAuditEntry): Promise<void>`; inject the upstream repository via `AUDIT_ENTRY_REPOSITORY`. `AuditLogModule` keeps repository and storage bindings private and will export only services added by later stories.

**Verification** — Build storage directly with a capturing stub repository. Base entry: action 'ticket.create', resource 'ticket', resourceId 't1', actor { id: 'u1', type: 'USER' }, correlationId 'c1', timestamp T, metadata { projectId: 'p1', onBehalfOf: null, origin: 'rest', approval: NO_APPROVAL, summary: null }. Compile AuditLogModule in a unit spec with mocked global PrismaService and TRANSACTION_MANAGER providers, and close its TestingModule. Extend those global mocks as later stories register services/controller; never move the DI proof to integration tests.

analysis:
Goal and completion: deliver the durable AuditEntry store, the @nathapp/nestjs-audit IAuditStorage adapter, a transaction-bound AuditRecorder, and the globally permission-gated GET /api/audit. This is P2 feature three of seven, after context and context-guard and before audit-core, audit-fleet, audit-integrations and web. No production domain writer calls the recorder in this feature. Completion means all six binding stories' observable contracts are implemented, the new migration and generated OpenAPI operation are committed, and DB-backed behavior is actually verified outside the sandbox. Preserve story ids, workdirs and dependency edges exactly.

Navigation and actual stack: codebase-memory MCP is unavailable in this session; findings use direct Read/Grep/Glob fallback. The supplied Express/Next.js labels are not authoritative: apps/api/src/main.ts:11 creates a Fastify app through AppFactory, and .nax/mono/apps/api/context.md:21 identifies NestJS 12, Prisma 7, Vitest and oxlint. Follow Nathapp repository/service/public patterns, not generic Express implementations. Read the nathapp-nestjs-patterns skill before writing NestJS code if available to the implementation host; no matching repository skill path was found during drafting. apps/api/package.json:46-61 confirms @nathapp/nestjs-audit and the other main Nathapp packages are already ~4.2.3, notify and notify-prisma ~1.3.0, tenant 1.3.0. Dependency upgrades and CLI generation are not implementation tasks. apps/api/src/audit does not exist at drafting time.

Existing context contract: apps/api/src/action-context/action-context.ts:24-60 defines ActorType USER|AGENT, ActionActorType (FleetActorType, including RUNNER and SYSTEM), ActionOrigin rest|mcp|thread|runner|system, ActionApproval, ActionContext and NO_APPROVAL. currentContext at :101 returns undefined outside a run. runWithActionContext at :87 supplies approval and correlation defaults; runAsSystem at :125 validates system actor ids and preserves optional onBehalfOf; runWithActor at :155 gives rest origin. Reuse these unchanged. The full actor, on-behalf-of, origin, approval and correlation block must survive through recorder metadata, adapter columns and DTO reconstruction. Never infer identity from a resource owner or from authentication anew. The recorder must not install an ActionContext merely to make a context-less insert pass.

Existing persistence seam: apps/api/src/app.module.ts:88-98 globally registers PrismaModule with KodaPrismaClient and transaction:true; apps/api/src/permissions/permissions.module.ts:35-58 globally provides PermissionService. AuditLogModule therefore needs no imports. apps/api/src/prisma/koda-prisma-client.ts:5-9 installs a top-level all-operations extension, and :17-29 ensures interactive transactions retain it. apps/api/src/action-context/contextless-write.ts:28-55 chooses throw outside production and logs/runs SYSTEM/unknown in production record mode. A context-less recorder call with a mocked storage may return its SYSTEM/unknown fallback, but the real dev/test insert must still fail ContextlessWriteError. Do not bypass or weaken that guard.

Repository rules and library reality: .nax/rules/api-repositories.md:13-43 requires AbstractPrismaRepository plus a private repository symbol; .nax/rules/api-data.md:21-52 keeps repositories private and exports services only; :81-99 requires txManager.run, never manual transaction threading. apps/api/src/webhook/prisma-webhook.repository.ts:15-50 supplies the inheritance/injection/mapping precedent, but its legacy casts and special methods are not permission to copy anti-patterns. Installed apps/api/node_modules/@nathapp/nestjs-prisma/dist/repository/abstract-prisma.repository.d.ts:36-50 declares the current protected delegate signature; implement the spec contract with the installed library's compatible typing rather than introducing an unsafe custom client. The installed abstract implementation at abstract-prisma.repository.js:23-29 gets the active client from tx.getClient; :49-58 maps before create/update. Thus an append-only toPersistenceUpdate throws before issuing an update. Its findOne and count(criteria) also use this mapping (:31-34, :42-47) and are unsupported here; delete remains inherited but must never be exposed or called. Append-only is an application repository contract, not a promise of a database trigger.

Schema and migration: apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma:829-847 shows the FleetActivity precedent storing unreferenced actor/project identifiers and timestamps. Add only the new AuditEntry model with all eighteen named columns and seven secondary indexes, no Prisma enums, relations, FKs, existing-model edits or backfill. Keep ids after principals/projects/resources disappear. Use exactly prisma/migrations/20261103090000_audit_entry/migration.sql, then bun run db:generate from apps/api because generated Prisma files are ignored and imports must come from src/generated/prisma/client. The main DB harness uses schema push, so migration correctness needs its own scratch-schema test: apps/api/test/helpers/migration-schema.ts:22-33 orders/applies committed SQL and :41-63 builds all predecessors and drops the scratch schema. Index checks should enumerate the seven secondary index field lists separately from the primary key. Repository integration cases initially instantiate the repository directly under booted AppModule, since module provisioning arrives only in US-002.

Read path: apps/api/src/fleet/activity/prisma-fleet-activity.repository.ts:21-30 demonstrates Paginate with orderBy createdAt desc, id desc and page remapping. Reuse Paginate over this.prisma.client.auditEntry with bounded pagination and conjunctive optional filters for key, actorType, actorId, approverId, projectId, resourceType, resourceId and inclusive createdAt gte/lte. apps/api/src/common/dto/koda-page.query.ts:16-33 sets current=1, size=20, max=100; :59-69 transforms numbers/defaults and strips undeclared query keys; :72-77 preserves the public page envelope and maps records. Controller must parseQuery before passing page arguments and use JsonResponse.Ok(toPageResult(...)). AuditLogService is a justified concrete-repository injection for findPage, whereas storage uses AUDIT_ENTRY_REPOSITORY.

Adapter design: installed apps/api/node_modules/@nathapp/nestjs-audit/dist/interface/audit-entry.interface.d.ts:1-14 makes actor.type and other fields optional, so explicit Koda validation is essential. audit-storage.interface.d.ts:2-5 makes query optional; do not implement it. Use type-only PackageAuditEntry alias to avoid collision with the generated model, and import only the AUDIT_STORAGE runtime token. The package's generic metadata is Record<string, unknown>; preserve the KodaAuditMetadata structure through explicit mapping compatible with that type rather than leaking Prisma models. Do not import AuditModule or instantiate AuditInterceptor, @Audit, RequestContextService or a CLOCK dependency. Koda binds AUDIT_STORAGE and AUDIT_ENTRY_REPOSITORY using useExisting so resolution returns the actual provider instances, not duplicate instances. Validate missing fields in the exact specified order before create; do not invent additional validation that changes the first-error behavior.

Recorder and atomicity: validate a permission catalog key before checking isInTransaction, read currentContext only after both checks, slice summary to the first 500 UTF-16 code units (not code points or bytes), assign a new Date, and pass context fields unchanged in metadata. With no context use SYSTEM/unknown, system, NO_APPROVAL, no on-behalf-of and a fresh randomUUID per call. Never open a separate transaction, swallow a storage error, enqueue an asynchronous write or record after commit. Failure of the audit insert fails the domain write; the missing-context production fallback is the only availability exception. US-003 establishes normal mapping and application provisioning; US-004 remains a distinct, binding behavior-hardening story for refusals, fallback and rollback even though its strongest proofs are tests. Tests must prove both an audit insert disappears when the enclosing transaction throws and a domain label disappears when recorder refusal aborts the transaction.

Service and UTC semantics: AuditLogService expands date-only from to midnight UTC and date-only to to 23:59:59.999 UTC. Instants ending Z stay exact; equal bounds are allowed. This differs intentionally from the half-open analytics window in apps/api/src/fleet/analytics/analytics-window.ts:20-29; do not copy its exclusive to, minimum positive span, 30-day default or maximum-window rules. Reversed bounds throw ValidationAppException({ reason: 'from must not be after to' }, 'audit.auditQuery') before repository access. apps/api/src/fleet/activity/dto/fleet-activity.dto.ts:4-31 is the decorated response/ISO timestamp mapping precedent. outOfScope: Calling `AuditRecorder.record` from any domain write, service, tool or system writer is out of scope (features `permissions-p2-audit-core`, `permissions-p2-audit-fleet` and `permissions-p2-audit-integrations`).
Generalising `src/koda-domain-writer/` into the command layer that records audit entries is out of scope (feature `permissions-p2-audit-core`).

Choosing what each writer puts in `summary`, and redacting secrets from it, is out of scope; each writer feature (audit-core, audit-fleet, audit-integrations) owns its summaries, and the recorder only caps the length.

The runtime coverage guard (dev/test throw when a request, tool or system run commits a domain write with no `AuditEntry`) and the walker test over write surfaces are out of scope (feature `permissions-p2-audit-integrations`).
The web Audit log page is out of scope (feature `permissions-p2-web`).

Using the package's `AuditInterceptor`, `@Audit` decorator, `AuditModule`, `DefaultActorResolver` or `InMemoryAuditStorage` is out of scope (ruling: the command layer writes entries; designer's call: the module is not imported).
Implementing `IAuditStorage.query` is out of scope (optional in the package; `GET /api/audit` reads through the repository).
Retention or purging of `AuditEntry` rows is out of scope; rows are kept indefinitely until a later feature adds a retention policy.
Deleting an `AuditEntry` row is out of scope; no code path calls the repository's `delete`.

The base-class `findOne` and `count(criteria)` are unsupported on `PrismaAuditEntryRepository` (both route criteria through `toPersistenceUpdate`, which throws); reads go through `findById` and `findPage` only.
A CLI `koda audit` command and regenerating `apps/cli/src/generated/` are out of scope.
Granting `audit.read` to any project role, or scoping `GET /api/audit` per project by key, is out of scope (`audit.read` is a global key).
Bumping `@nathapp/nestjs-*` and adding `@nathapp/nestjs-audit` is out of scope for the stories; it is already committed on the branch.

Filtering by `onBehalfOfId`, `origin` or `correlationId` in `GET /api/audit` is out of scope (the design's filter list is actor, approver, key, project and date; resource is added for the web page's per-resource view).
An `AuditEntryDto` component schema in `openapi.json` is out of scope (the route's `@ApiResponse` carries no `type`, as on `FleetActivityController`).
US-006 only: rate limiting `GET /api/audit` beyond the app's global throttler is out of scope (a global-admin read route, same as `GET /api/fleet/activity`).
